title: 第十三章进山第十四章打猎收获突发状况
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
翌日。
天蒙蒙亮，顾晦就起身出门了。
徐翠娘比他起得还早，昨天晚上，顾晦告诉徐翠娘，说是今日要进山去打猎。
以前，顾长青也是一早进山。
在这之前，徐翠娘会早起为他准备早饭以及干粮，干粮的多少根据他在山里面待的时间而定。
顾晦今早出门，她也早起为顾晦准备干粮。
没能加入打猎队的事，顾晦和徐翠娘说了。
这两日，经历了太多的失望，徐翠娘对不幸的承受力提高了不少，念叨了几句也就认了，甚至，还对顾长青隐瞒了这个消息，不想让他更难受。
顾长青一直以为顾晦加入了打猎队。
昨晚他入睡前，拉着顾晦说了许多话，提醒他进山的各种忌讳，让他要认真听队友们的话，千万不要特立独行，若是做错事被训斥，一定要忍着。
顾晦独自进山，徐翠娘其实是反对的。
进山打猎是一件危险的事情，猎户难免山中亡，每年都有一些有名的老猎手死在山里面，那些寂寂无名的人就更多了，这还是大家组成打猎队抱团取暖的情况。
独来独往的山客有没有？
有！
这些山客最差也是一次淬体大圆满的武者，并非像顾长青这样连一次淬体都不圆满的残次品。
顾晦再三告诉徐翠娘，说自己只在一道梁的范围打猎，绝不深入二道梁，也不会在山里面过夜，天黑前必定会下山，也不会去招惹猛兽，这才得到了许可。
徐翠娘不同意也不行啊！
秋收刚过，家里面的粮食倒还有些，只是，为了给顾长青治病，存银已经耗尽。
不管是哪个世界，底层百姓的生活都是如此，开门第一件事，柴米油盐酱醋茶。
何况，这个世界远比前世残酷，有点像前世的古代。

人头税，土地税，各种苛捐杂税，这些都需要银钱。
哪怕不需要一百两白银购买黑玉断续膏，银钱也必不可少，徐翠娘要照顾顾长青，没法出外干活，顾瑜年龄也小，只能依靠顾晦，再是担心他的安全也没法拉着他让他不要进山。
顾瑜也起得很早。
她和徐翠娘一起把顾晦送到了门口，倚在门框上目送背着弓箭挎着猎刀的顾晦身影远去，哪怕他已经消失在了巷口，两人依旧站在原地不曾回屋。
“娘，阿兄会平安回来吧？”
顾瑜仰着头，小脸上满是担心。
“会的，肯定会的！”
“你阿兄懂事了，他那么聪明，一定会没事的，一定会平平安安地回到家！”
徐翠娘望着空空无人的巷口，哽咽着说道。
……
天已经大亮。
太阳从东边一跃而起。
顾晦来到了刀疤六的院子门前。
“刀疤！”
“归老二！”
content_en:
The next day.
As the sky dawned, Gu Hui got up and went out.
Xu Cuiniang got up earlier than him. Last night, Gu Hui told Xu Cuiniang that she was going to go hunting in the mountains today.
In the past, Gu Changqing also went into the mountains early in the morning.
Before that, Xu Cuiniang would get up early to prepare breakfast and dry food for him. The amount of dry food depended on the time he spent in the mountains.
Gu Hui went out this morning, and she also got up early to prepare dry food for Gu Hui.
Gu Hui talked to Xu Cuiniang about not being able to join the hunting team.
After experiencing too many disappointments in the past two days, Xu Cuiniang's tolerance for misfortune has improved a lot, and she accepted it after a few words. She even hid the news from Gu Changqing, not wanting to make him feel more uncomfortable.
Gu Changqing always thought that Gu Hui had joined the hunting team.
Before he went to sleep last night, he pulled Gu Hui and talked a lot, reminding him of all the taboos about going into the mountains, telling him to listen carefully to his teammates, never to act independently, and to endure it if he did something wrong and was reprimanded.
Xu Cuiniang was actually opposed to Gu Hui going into the mountains alone.
Hunting in the mountains is a dangerous thing. Hunters will inevitably die in the mountains. Every year, some famous old hunters die in the mountains, and there are even more unknown ones. This is a situation where everyone forms a hunting team and hugs each other to keep warm.
Are there any lone hikers?
have!
The worst of these monks are warriors who have perfected their body tempering once, and are not defective products like Gu Changqing who have not even perfected their body tempering once.
Gu Hui repeatedly told Xu Cuiniang that he would only hunt within the scope of the first beam, and would never go deep into the second beam, nor would he spend the night in the mountain. He would definitely go down the mountain before dark, and would not provoke wild beasts. Only then did he get permission.
It doesn’t matter if Xu Cuiniang doesn’t agree!
The autumn harvest had just passed, and there was still some food in the house. However, the savings had been exhausted in order to treat Gu Changqing's illness.
No matter which world it is in, the life of the people at the bottom is like this. The first thing they do when they open the door is firewood, rice, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar and tea.
What's more, this world is far more cruel than the previous life, a bit like the ancient times in the previous life.
Poll tax, land tax, various exorbitant taxes and miscellaneous taxes all require money.
Even if you don't need one hundred taels of silver to buy black jade intermittent ointment, money is still essential. Xu Cuiniang has to take care of Gu Changqing and cannot go out to work. Gu Yu is also young and can only rely on Gu Hui. No matter how worried about his safety, she can't hold him back from going into the mountains.
Gu Yu also got up early.
She and Xu Cuiniang sent Gu Hui to the door together, leaning on the door frame and watching Gu Hui's figure, who was carrying a bow and arrows and a hunting knife, go away. Even though he had disappeared at the entrance of the alley, the two of them still stood there and never returned to the house.
"Mom, will brother come back safely?"
Gu Yu raised her head, her face full of worry.
"Yes, definitely!"
"Your brother is sensible. He is so smart. He will be fine and return home safely!"
Xu Cuiniang looked at the deserted alley and said with choked sobs.
…
It's daybreak.
The sun rises from the east.
Gu Hui came to the door of Dao Scar Liu's courtyard.
"Scar!"
"Return to the second child!"
